expected_root_cause: PostgreSQL became unavailable after its container was paused.
expected_symptoms: Dependent services return HTTP 500 or 503 responses.
Database connection errors and OperationalError log messages increase.
Request latency rises while clients wait for database connections.
expected_evidence: Docker events show the postgres container paused and later unpaused.
Dependent-service logs contain database connection failures or OperationalError messages.
Prometheus HTTP 5xx counters and request-duration metrics increase.
Jaeger traces contain failed database spans.
expected_resolution: Safely unpause the postgres container; do not delete or recreate its volume. Verify dependent-service health checks and error rates return to baseline.

timeline.event: Capture normal database connectivity, request latency, and error-rate metrics.
Dependent requests begin failing or waiting for database connections.
Unpause postgres and confirm application errors and latency recover.
